sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/107 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: search/place for PlaceId 107, search/grid for facilities 384 'A thru G', 385 'J thru R', 386 Equestrian, 387 Group, search/details for all 298 web-listed units on 2027-06-15, plus sites A01 and B01 on 2027-06-19, 2027-01-12 and 2026-11-17, read 2026-10-30)

values.note: Electric sites $41 a night, full hookups $56, the same on a Saturday (June 2027). Off-peak (November 2026, January 2027) every open site is $37, full-hookup sites with sewer but no water. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all Alum Creek units, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Electric 41.00, Campsite Full Hookup 56.00, Fee 6.50); site A01 (electric) and B01 (full hookup) on Sat 2027-06-19 (41.00 / 56.00), 2027-01-12 and 2026-11-17 (37.00 / 37.00); https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/alum-creek-state-park-campground ('Sewer, but no water at Full Hook-up sites' off-peak), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: ReserveOhio search/details (Electricity Hookup '50' on 278 campsites; Water Hookup and Sewer Hookup 'Yes' on the full-hookup sites) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/alum-creek-state-park-campground ('37 full-service campsites offer electric, sewer, and water hookups'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 279 web-bookable RV campsites in two areas (A-G and J-R): 242 electric and 37 full hookup, all back-in pads 45-65 ft long (most 47-50 ft). ReserveOhio's '292 sites' adds the 13 primitive equestrian sites north of US 36. ODNR: wooded and sunny areas, 'some overlook the lake'; pets welcome on all sites. A camper cabin and four Sherman cabins (April-December) sit in the campground.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/place ('Alum Creek State Park campground has 292 sites') + search/details (UnitType, PullInTypeName 'Back In', Maximum Camping Unit Length / Pad Length 45-65 per site) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/alum-creek-state-park-campground ('286 electric campsites offer both wooded and sunny areas; some overlook the lake', 'Pets are welcome on all sites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Heated shower facilities; a beach and boat ramp for the exclusive use of campers. Off-peak (Nov. 1 - Apr. 15) restrooms are closed.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/alum-creek-state-park-campground ('Heated shower facilities with flush toilets', 'Dump station', 'Beach and boat ramp for exclusive use of campers', off-peak 'Restrooms are closed') + ReserveOhio search/details ('Distance to Drinking Water' per site), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Off-peak November 1 to April 15: Area 2 rows A, B and G stay open, other areas limited; restrooms closed, full-hookup sites without water.

season.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/alum-creek-state-park-campground ('Off-Peak: From Nov. 1 to Apr. 15, Area 2; A, B, G rows available; Other areas limited availability. Sewer, but no water at Full Hook-up sites. Restrooms are closed.') + ReserveOhio rates for 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-30

values.note: Reservations required, up to six months ahead online or at (866) 644-6727; no self-registration. Every listed site is web-bookable with a 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 1 p.m.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/alum-creek-state-park-campground ('Reservations are required and may be made up to six months in advance, online or by calling (866) 644-6727. There is no self-registration.') + ReserveOhio search/details (AllowWebBooking true on every unit, MaxStay 14, CheckInStarts 15:00, CheckOutTime 13:00), read 2026-10-30

summary: Fees confirmed ($41 electric base, +$15 full hookup) and added the $37 off-peak rate. Added 50-amp electric with water/sewer at the 37 full-hookup sites, 279 back-in RV sites to 65 ft, heated showers/flush toilets/water/dump, year-round season with the off-peak rows, ReserveOhio deep link, 6-month window, no walk-ups, 14-night max. Pin is 150 m from the centre of the 284 site coordinates (fine). Not stated for this park: the weekend minimum (left inherited).
flags: Phone missing: the ODNR campground page gives (740) 548-4039 (the park office is (740) 548-4631, 8-4:30 weekdays).

Waterfront re-audit lead: stored 'not waterfront', but ODNR says '286 electric campsites ... some overlook the lake' (campground page) and 'some premium sites overlook the lake' (park page).
